title: Disk space
description: Space USED on the disks of one host, chosen with the Host dropdown. Source is picked per host: the ZFS pool exporter where it exists (beast, malina5 -- one series per pool, exact), otherwise derived from node_filesystem and shown as a single 'all filesystems' series (thunder, surfer). The derived figures were validated against zfs_pool_allocated_bytes on beast and malina5 (agree within 0.1%) and against `zpool list` CAP on thunder (12.2% computed vs 12% reported). Note the inverse -- free space -- is not simply 100% minus these figures on ZFS: pool slop space means allocated + free does not exactly equal size. Giving thunder the ZFS pool exporter would move it onto the exact per-pool source; see homelab-docs decisions/thunder-zfs-module-and-root-rollback.md.

panels.title: Space used (%)
panels.description: Used as a share of total capacity. ZFS performance degrades as a pool fills; past ~80% used expect fragmentation and slower writes, which is where the amber band starts. Source is picked per host: the ZFS pool exporter where it exists (beast, malina5 -- one series per pool, exact), otherwise derived from node_filesystem and shown as a single 'all filesystems' series (thunder, surfer).

targets.expr: 100 * zfs_pool_allocated_bytes{host="$host"} / zfs_pool_size_bytes{host="$host"} or (label_replace(100 * (sum by (host) (max by (host, device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"}))) / ((sum by (host) (max by (host, device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"}))) + max by (host) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"})), "pool", "all filesystems", "", "") unless on(host) zfs_pool_size_bytes{host="$host"})

panels.title: Space used

panels.title: Total size
panels.description: Total capacity, for context against the used figures. For the derived hosts this is used + free rather than a reported pool size, so it can read a few percent high (thunder: 78.8 GB derived vs 76 GB actual).

targets.expr: zfs_pool_size_bytes{host="$host"} or (label_replace(((sum by (host) (max by (host, device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"}))) + max by (host) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"})), "pool", "all filesystems", "", "") unless on(host) zfs_pool_size_bytes{host="$host"})

panels.title: Space used over time (%)
panels.description: The slope is the useful part: a steady climb tells you roughly when a disk will need attention. Dashed line marks 80% used.

targets.expr: 100 * zfs_pool_allocated_bytes{host="$host"} / zfs_pool_size_bytes{host="$host"} or (label_replace(100 * (sum by (host) (max by (host, device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"}))) / ((sum by (host) (max by (host, device) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"}))) + max by (host) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs", host="$host"})), "pool", "all filesystems", "", "") unless on(host) zfs_pool_size_bytes{host="$host"})
